system.description:
Your words and bearing command the regard of all who witness them; a crowd leans in to hear you, and even the skeptical find their objections softening as you speak, so that your arguments are heeded more often than not.

You may expend one Social Trait during any Social Challenge to demand an automatic retest. You may use this ability in mass Social Challenges, but you must expend one Social Trait per opponent. Leadership serves for any further retest of this Discipline.
